_comment: Copy to config.json, fill in, version it with the project, then run: python build.py. Nothing here is secret: the build refuses obvious secrets. Reference: README.md
_name: The plugin's name: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. It also names the local server, so the project's tools appear as mcp__plugin_<name>_<name>__<tool>.
name: example-project
description: Tools and rules of the Example project, next to eunomai-business.
_uv: The same uv as eunomai-business's build: IT deploys it at a fixed version and absolute path.
_repositories: The project's repositories (https). A workspace eunomai-business cloned from one of them is the project's.
_deny: Paths the project protects in its workspaces, relative to the workspace and with /: * inside one folder, ** at any depth (folder/** for everything in a folder). The reason is what Claude tells the user.

deny.reason: raw data comes from the nightly import; change the import, not the copy

_settings: Values the project's tools read (addresses, names). Never a secret.
